texts.preamble: S.J.Antony vs State Of Kerala Represented By The on 18 July, 2011 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam Present: The Honourable Mr.Justice K.Harilal Tuesday, The 19Th Day Of January 2016/29Th Pousha, 1937 WP(C).No. 25550 of 2011 (P) ---------------------------- Petitioner(S): -------------- 1. S.J.Antony,Aged 43 Years, S/O. S.A. Joseph, Sankkurickal House, Narakkal.P.O Ernakulam-682505. 2. V.V. Alias, Aged 63 Years, S/O. Varkey, Vellookkattil House, Piravom, Ernakulam-686664. By Advs.Sri.R.Sanjith Smt.Lijitta G.Mathew Smt.S.K.Sreekala Respondent(S): -------------- 1. State Of Kerala Represented By The Secretary Health, Secretariat, Thiruvananthapuram. Pin-695001. 2. The Food Inspector, Muvattupuzha Circle, Office Of The District Food Inspector, Eroor South, Ernakulam District-682306. 3. The District Food Inspector & Local (Health) Authority, Office Of The District Food Inspector, Eroor South, Ernakulam District-682306. R1 By Government Pleader Sri.Noushad Thottathil This Writ Petition (Civil) Having Been Finally Heard On 19-01-2016, The Court On The Same Day Delivered The Following: S.J.Antony vs State Of Kerala Represented By The on 18 July, 2011 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15289112/ 1 WP(C).No. 25550 of 2011 (P) Appendix Petitioner(S) Exhibits : Ext.P1 True Copy Of The Notice Under Rule-12 Issued To The 1St Petitioner. Ext .P2
texts.facts: ~ The first and the second petitioners are the first and second accused respectively in C.C.No.302/2011 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate's Court, Muvattupuzha. The above complaint was instituted by the 2nd respondent alleging violation of Rule 29 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules, 1955. The subject matter of challenge in this writ petition is with regard to the power of the 2nd respondent to file another complaint on the date before the learned Magistrate's Court in view of the introduction of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, its Rules and Regulations, which are brought into force on and with effect from 29.7.2010 and 3.7.2011 respectively. According to the petitioners, in view of the repealing provisions contained under WP(C).25550/11-P :2: S.J.Antony vs State Of Kerala Represented By The on 18 July, 2011 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15289112/ 2 Sections 97 and 89 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, the alleged complaint instituted before the Judicial First Class Magistrate's Court, Muvattupuzha by the 2nd respondent is void ab initio and illegal. Hence the petitioners have prayed for quashing Exts.P1 to P3. 2.
texts.arguments: The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the matter in issue involved in this writ petition has been decided in their favour in W.P(C) No.7366/2011 and connected cases by this Court. The learned Government Pleader also agrees with the said submission.
texts.petitioner_arguments: The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the matter in issue involved in this writ petition has been decided in their favour in W.P(C) No.7366/2011 and connected cases by this Court. The learned Government Pleader also agrees with the said submission.
